items.title: Welcome
items.text:
This is your board. Add anything and it shows up here.

- Tap **Photos** to add pictures or videos
- Tap **Files** for anything else
- Paste a link, or type a note, and press **Add**
- Tap **Slideshow** to see everything full screen
